description: This file defines a TabAdapter class for managing fragments in an Android application's tab interface related to receipts, specifically providing fragments for listing receipts and adding receipts based on the tab position.

classes.name: TabAdapter
classes.description: An adapter class extending FragmentPagerAdapter to handle tabbed navigation for receipt-related fragments.

methods.name: TabAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with context, fragment manager, and total number of tabs.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the appropriate Fragment instance based on the tab position.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of tabs.
